text: Ironvale Athletic effectively exploited the spaces behind Redmond Rovers’ high defensive line by utilizing direct, vertical passing within their low block and deep defensive line setup, leading to multiple quality shots and eventually Ilias Thorne’s equalizing goal at 86'. Their increased possession (61.5%) and improved pass accuracy (78.0%) in the final minutes allowed them to sustain pressure and control the game's momentum despite Redmond’s higher field tilt. In contrast, Redmond’s high press was less effective in disrupting Ironvale’s buildup, as indicated by their higher PPDA (7.6) and fewer box touches (3) compared to Ironvale’s 7. To prevent such momentum shifts, work on adjusting your pressing triggers and coordination to reduce spaces behind the defense when committing players forward.
